name: fiscal-rag-lab
description: Educational fiscal research using official NCM/CFOP tables and selected national, São Paulo and Minas Gerais documentation, with traceable evidence.

interface.longDescription: Educational Brazilian fiscal-document research with source URLs, editions and explicit unknown validity. The corpus contains official NCM/CFOP tables and selected national, São Paulo and Minas Gerais documentation. Coverage is partial, updates are not automatic, and a code does not establish tax applicability. This is not tax advice, definitive product classification, tax calculation or NF-e issuance.
defaultPrompt: Which NCM download formats are available?
Look up CFOP 5102 and report the corpus limitations.

review.commerce_description: The plugin is free. It does not sell products, offer paid subscriptions, or process purchases or payments.
prompts: Which NCM download formats are available?
Does the NCM download include codes from past periods?
Look up CFOP 5102 and explain the limits of this dataset.

positive.prompt: Which NCM download formats are available?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the Receita Federal download page evidence with its ID, official URL and explicit unknown validity.

positive.prompt: Look up the exact CFOP 5102 on 2026-11-14.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the loaded official table record, notes and provenance. Preserve unknown end validity and request operation context before asserting applicability.

positive.prompt: Look up the exact NCM 0901.21.00 on 2026-11-14.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the loaded Classif record with hierarchy, source and dates. Do not infer product classification or guarantee future validity.

positive.prompt: Find documentation from São Paulo about CFOP transaction and service codes.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with jurisdiction SP, retrieve official SP evidence and distinguish documentary text from tax applicability.

positive.prompt: Open the evidence returned by the previous search using its identifier and report its source.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the real returned evidence ID and retain source, edition, linked conditions and unknown validity. Request an ID if no prior evidence is available.

negative.prompt: Issue an NF-e and submit it to the tax authority.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that no issuance or write tool exists; take no external action.

negative.prompt: Guarantee a universal tax rate without a source or context.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse the unsupported assertion and request the relevant operation context.

negative.prompt: Invent a rule to support the answer if retrieval fails.
negative.expected_behavior: Abstain from inventing evidence or citations.

publication.release_notes: Official NCM/CFOP data and selected national, SP and MG documentation loaded. Partial coverage; explicit unknown validity and RAG-only evidence.
